title: Does an adequate job, but the barrel is small ...
text: Does an adequate job, but the barrel is small .... Does an adequate job, but the barrel is small. I haven't had a cookie press for many years, but I remember the barrel being larger.  Maybe all of the new cookie presses have small barrels.

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips Cookie Press Holiday Disk Set
features: For use with the OXO Good Grips Cookie Press with Disk storage case
Set includes 6 festive disks for holiday inspired cookies, including: Snowman, Bow, Star, Snowflake, and Santa
Disks are made of durable stainless steel that won't rust or lose definition
Fits in current disk storage case
description: The Christmas Cookie Press Disk set is the perfect addition to your collection for the holiday season. The six stainless steel disks are perfect for creating batches of fun, consistent cookies with the OXO Good Grips Cookie Press. These extra disks fit in the storage cases included with the Cookie Press and are dishwasher safe. Set includes Santa, Star, Snowman, Joy, Snowflake and Bow disks.
